topic: FINANCE 101: De-rating (P/E compression) - Nifty 50's 12-month forward P/E fell 31% from 24.8x in Sep 2024 to 17.2x in Sep 2026 (Bajaj AMC), while Q2 FY27 Nifty-50 profit is up about 19% YoY on results declared so far (Kotak); the multiple did the falling, not the earnings. Nifty P/E (TTM) 19.30 on 30/10/2026 (NSE).

MONEY STORY (weekend lesson): compounding math - Rs 5,000 a month for 20 years at an assumed 12% a year = Rs 12 lakh invested, about Rs 49.5 lakh back; first 10 years build ~Rs 11.5 lakh, the last 10 add ~Rs 38 lakh (end-of-month SIP convention); no live market call, Sunday market closed, Friday close Sensex 74,459.53 (+308.49, +0.42%) and Nifty 23,053.10 (+116.35, +0.51%)

GEOPOLITICS: RBI has reportedly proposed a Rs 50 lakh per-year sub-limit under the LRS for business travel, pilgrimages and high-ticket trips (reported 27/10/2026, no start date; education and medical likely exempt), inside today's $2.5 lakh (~Rs 2.37 cr) yearly cap; travel is ~60% of money Indians send abroad; rupee fell ~7% in 12 months from 88.84 to 94.95 (30/10 close, Reuters) and RBI is estimated to have sold $75-80 bn since June to slow the fall

MONEY STORY: the consumer never got the slowdown memo - October gross GST Rs 2,31,290 crore (+22.9% YoY, fastest this fiscal, second-highest on comparable basis after April 2026's Rs 2,42,702 cr; net Rs 2,03,356 cr +25.6%), UPI record 25.47 bn payments worth Rs 31.53 lakh crore, car sales 5.25 lakh units (first month above 5 lakh); Sensex up ~900 pts / Nifty ~23,313 on the day

PRE-MARKET: Nasdaq -2.86% (25,437) on the AI-spend rout, worst month since March 2025, yet Gift Nifty ~23,290 (+~200 pts) on Brent cooling to $111 from $117.64; Nifty closed 23,053.10 with 23,200 the wall and 22,850 the floor, Sensex 74,459.53 with 75,000/73,800; rupee 94.94, FIIs bought Rs 3,598 cr Friday, US midterms 03/11

FINANCE 101: Crack spread - the gap between crude oil and the fuel a refiner sells. RIL's Q2 FY27 fuel cracks ran 3-3.7x YoY and O2C EBITDA hit Rs 25,203 cr (+67.9%), but Singapore's petrol crack fell from a record $50.53/bbl (1 Oct 2026) to about $11 (30 Oct 2026), lowest since March

MARKET WRAP: FIIs net bought Rs 6,836.81 crore and DIIs net sold Rs 3,678.85 crore in the cash market on 03/11/2026 (NSE provisional) yet the index rose - Sensex 76,917.85 (+1,225.07 pts, +1.62%), Nifty 23,810.85 (+370.05 pts, +1.58%), fourth straight green day and a two-month high

GEOPOLITICS: gold ~30% below its January 2026 record just before Dhanteras - spot gold under $3,900/oz (one-year low) on 30/10/2026, MCX gold under Rs 1.40 lakh per 10g on 03/11/2026, October the worst October since 2008 (gold -7%, silver ~-18%); cause: oil-led inflation and December Fed hike bets, gold pays no interest; Dhanteras 06/11/2026

EVENT/MARKET ALERT (2:30 PM monitor): SEBI recommended scrapping the 12.5% LTCG tax for foreign investors (Reuters, 02/11/2026) and FM Sitharaman said she will consider the demand - Sensex rose 1,049 pts (+1.39%) to 76,741.90 and Nifty +293.50 (+1.25%) to 23,734.30 on 03/11/2026, adding about Rs 4 lakh crore to BSE market value (total Rs 486 lakh crore); FPI outflows Rs 2.91 lakh crore in 2026

MONEY STORY: foreign money owns the least of India since Dec 2011 - FPI stake in BSE-listed firms 14.02% at Sept quarter end (lowest since Dec 2011, Mint/CMIE), domestic MF ownership a record 11.59%, gap down to 2.43 pp from 4.77 pp; FIIs sold Rs 45,162 cr in October (NSE provisional) then bought Rs 9,420 cr in six sessions to 02/11, DIIs net sellers Rs 392 cr on 02/11; Nifty 4th straight up session, ~23,691 (+1.07%), Sensex ~76,626 (+1.23%) at noon 03/11

EVENT/MARKET ALERT (6:30 PM monitor): SEBI circular dated 05/11/2026 - domestic clients and FPIs may take long or short positions in INR currency derivatives with NO underlying exposure up to USD 5 million notional, one combined limit across all rupee pairs and all exchanges; FPI total short positions capped at USD 5m and longs above that need Indian equity/debt backing; follows RBI's 10/10/2026 FX derivatives changes

EVENT/MARKET ALERT (10:30 AM monitor): US midterm sweep - Democrats won both chambers of Congress; Sensex hit 78,922.44 (+1,621.04 pts, +2.10%) and Nifty topped 24,391.95 (+431.35, +1.80%) on 05/11/2026, sixth straight winning session; Brent fell to $93.5/bbl, lowest since 30/08, after an 8.7% slide; rupee firmed to 94.36; India m-cap crossed Rs 500 lakh crore; FIIs bought Rs 7,284 crore on 04/11, fourth straight session

MARKET WRAP: Sensex 81,028.02 (+2.17%), Nifty 25,030.35 (+2.01%) - seventh straight green day, Nifty above 25,000 for the first time since 27/02/2026; NSE cash flows FIIs net bought Rs 13,750 crore, DIIs net sold Rs 5,969 crore, so foreign money did the lifting while domestic funds sold into the rise; market cap up ~Rs 29.57 lakh crore since 28/10

EVENT/MARKET ALERT (6:30 PM monitor): Sensex closed 81,028.02 (+1,718.01 pts, +2.17%) and Nifty 25,030.35 (+493.75, +2.01%) on 06/11/2026, both at the day's high - first Sensex close above 80,000 since 05/03/2026 and Nifty's first close above 25,000 in 8 months; week +8.8%, best since Feb 2021; seventh straight session, longest in 26 months; India VIX +13.35%; Instagram reel + story also posted

GEOPOLITICS: Brent's 17% crash is already fading - settled $94.62 on 04/11 (from $113.43 on 30/10, lowest close since 31 Aug) then back near $100 by 06/11 on fresh tanker attacks; rupee 94.47 to 93.91, a six-month high; Delhi petrol unchanged at Rs 102.12; RBI: every $10 on Brent = ~49 bps of inflation

EVENT/MARKET ALERT (2:30 PM monitor): Sensex reclaimed 80,000 on 06/11/2026 - intraday high 80,080.59, up 718 pts (+0.90%), first time above 80,000 since 05/03/2026; rupee firmed to about 94 a dollar, strongest since April, on sliding crude; FIIs bought Rs 14,796 crore on 05/11, biggest single-day buy since Feb 2021; Nifty 24,698 (+0.66%)

MONEY STORY: the index is green, the portfolio is red - on 06/11/2026 Sensex traded ~+450 pts near 79,760 and Nifty above 24,600 despite a 5.52% Nasdaq crash, but Nifty Midcap 100 fell 1.2%, Smallcap 100 fell 1.7% and more NSE stocks fell than rose; M&M +4.5% on a 25% Q2 profit jump, Titan, TCS, Infosys led; engagement question 'Is your portfolio beating the Nifty?'

PRE-MARKET: overnight global cues - Nasdaq -5.52% to 24,315 (worst day since April 2025), S&P -4.36% to 7,354, Dow -3.44% to 51,523; Asia: Nikkei -5.8%, KOSPI -8.8% (circuit breaker), Hang Seng -1.6%; GIFT Nifty ~24,425; Nifty closed 24,536.60 (+2.40%), Sensex 79,310.01 (+2.60%), support 24,500 / Thursday low 24,308 / 24,800 August high; Brent ~$99, rupee 94.47; FIIs bought Rs 14,974.68 crore on 05/11

FINANCE 101: Net Short - FIIs net bought Rs 14,975 crore on 05/11/2026 (biggest single-day buy in over a year) yet stayed net short 1.37 lakh index futures, adding 48,541 shorts; hedging vs directional. Instagram: SIP vs Lumpsum carousel (SIP inflows record Rs 32,490 crore, Sep 2026)

EVENT/MARKET ALERT (2:30 AM monitor): Wall Street AI/chip selloff on 05/11/2026 - Nasdaq fell over 5% and is 11% below its record (correction), S&P 500 worst day since April 2025, chip index -10%, Nvidia -8%, AMD -14%; Gift Nifty 24,450 (-0.61%) after Nifty closed at 24,536.60

FESTIVAL GREETING: Dhanteras on 06/11/2026 - 24K gold Rs 14,642 per gram (Rs 1,46,420 per 10g), IBJA expects 12% higher Dhanteras sales after gold rose 4.56% in two days; jewellery carries 3% GST plus making charges vs coins and bars

EVENT/MARKET ALERT (6:30 PM monitor): Singapore International Commercial Court enforcement orders let the Sheriff seize and sell Tata Power's shares in Bhira Investments Pte Ltd and Tata Power International Pte Ltd; Kleros debt above USD 650 mn (about Rs 6,113 crore) - USD 490.32 mn damages plus 5.33% interest from 30/11/2020; TATAPOWER fell 3.44% to Rs 352.40 on 06/11; appeal filed 07/09/2026, submissions due 23/11/2026, hearing 19/01/2027, no stay; attachment notices served on both units 06/11/2026 and those shares are pledged to a lenders' consortium; stock in focus Monday 09/11 after Muhurat trading

GEOPOLITICS: gold's best week since August - MCX Dec gold Rs 1,42,364/10g on 06/11 (+4.5% week) as AI-stock fear pushed money into bullion, then Friday's US payrolls (165,000 vs 65,000 expected) lifted Dec Fed hike odds to ~81% and gold fell 1.20% on the day; retail 24K Rs 1,41,452/10g, India physical buying ahead of Diwali

MONEY STORY: SIP discipline in a red year - September 2026 SIP inflow hit a record Rs 32,490 crore (up Rs 193 crore on August, +10.7% YoY, AMFI data); equity funds took Rs 38,306.55 crore, 67th straight month of inflows; SIP assets Rs 17.86 lakh crore = 21.6% of industry AUM; set against Samvat 2082 ending down 4.0% (Sensex) and 3.1% (Nifty) on 06/11/2026

EVENT/MARKET ALERT (10:30 AM monitor): Trump confirmed fresh US strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island air defences on 06/11/2026, calling them 'minor'; Iran says it downed a US MQ-9 drone over Qeshm on the Strait of Hormuz route; Brent Jan settled $98.32 (+0.03%) on 06/11 after its steepest weekly fall since the Covid crash; India imports ~88% of its crude; Qatar mediating, Trump says talks show 'a lot of progress'

FINANCE 101: Samvat - the Hindu financial year (Diwali to Diwali, not Jan-Dec); Samvat 2082 ended as the weakest in 15 years with Sensex -4.0% and Nifty -3.1% (worst since 2011) yet its final week rose 8.6-8.8%, the biggest weekly gain in nearly six years; midcaps +2.1%, smallcaps +4.2%; 287 of Nifty 500 (57%) ended negative; Samvat 2083 opens at Muhurat trading Sunday 08/11/2026, 2:20-3:30 pm

FESTIVAL GREETING (2:30 AM monitor): Diwali on 08/11/2026 and the Muhurat trading session that opens Samvat 2083 - NSE and BSE trade 2:20 pm to 3:30 pm IST with pre-open from 2:05 pm; Samvat 2082 ended with Sensex -4.0% and Nifty -3.1% for the year, but the final week was the best since Feb 2021 with Sensex closing 81,028.02 (+2.17%) and Nifty 25,030.35 (+2.01%) on 06/11; markets shut Tuesday 10/11 for Diwali-Balipratipada

GEOPOLITICS: the rupee is half your gold price - global gold fell 21.4% in dollars from 30/01 to 30/10/2026 but only 14.9% in rupees (Axis MF report, Nov 2026), because the rupee slid from about 89 to 96 a dollar and gold import duty rose from 6% to 15% in 2026; MCX Dec gold closed Rs 1,43,106 per 10g on 09/11/2026, 21% below the Rs 1,80,779 January peak; MCX shut for Diwali-Balipratipada morning session, rupee closed 93.9275

FINANCE 101: EMI reset - India's October CPI is due today 12/11/2026 at 4 PM with consensus at 6.0% (Mint/Informist polls, range 5.9-6.2%), which would be the first breach of RBI's 6% limit since October 2024 against 5.54% in September; repo is 5.50% after the 07/10/2026 hike with a December hike to 5.75% widely expected; on a Rs 50 lakh 20-year loan at 8.50%, another 25 bps takes the EMI from Rs 43,391 to Rs 44,186 (Rs 794 more a month, about Rs 1.9 lakh over the term)

PRE-MARKET: Wall Street rallied on 11/11 (Dow +254.60 to 52,486.49, S&P 500 +1.31% to 7,619.38, Nasdaq +1.60% to 25,466.19) but Nvidia fell ~8% after hours on reports its board could consider removing CEO Jensen Huang; Nifty closed 25,255.05 (+210.40, +0.84%) and Sensex 81,879.40 (+772.75, +0.95%), both highest since 26/02/2026; support 25,095 (11/11 low) and resistance 25,424 (11/11 high), heaviest call OI 25,500, RSI 79.5; GIFT Nifty ~25,240 flat; Brent ~$92, rupee 93.69; India October CPI due 4 PM today with consensus near 6%

MONEY STORY: Brent jumped to $95.57 a barrel from $92 at Thursday's India close after Houthi strikes on Saudi pipeline/Yanbu/Aramco sites; Sensex fell 370 points to 81,539 and Nifty 158 to 25,141 by noon even as FIIs bought Rs 7,830.60 crore on 12/11; India imports most of its crude, so costlier oil hits the rupee, fuel prices and inflation

GEOPOLITICS: Brent fell early on 12/11 after Trump said the US needs no Iran deal, then jumped $3.06 to settle at $95.82 on Houthi claims against Saudi's East-West pipeline and Yanbu; ICRA's rule of thumb - each $10/bbl adds $14-16 bn to India's import bill, 30-40 bps to the current account and 40-60 bps to CPI; rupee closed at 94.20 on 13/11

MARKET WRAP: Sensex closed 318.56 points (-0.39%) lower at 81,592.45 and Nifty fell 155.05 points (-0.61%) to 25,144.30 on 13/11/2026, snapping a three-day rally on 6.09% October CPI and rate-hike worries; FIIs net bought Rs 5,736.55 crore in the cash market while DIIs net sold Rs 2,253.58 crore (NSE+BSE provisional), so foreign buying continued into a red tape

MARKET ALERT (2:30 AM monitor): Iran said it considers the Strait of Hormuz closed again after the IRGC said an LNG tanker hit a mine and exploded in the strait on 13/11; the US struck an Iranian island in the strait and Iran said it hit a US early-warning radar in Bahrain - sharpest direct US-Iran exchange since early September; UN Security Council met at Bahrain's request; Brent $95.86 a barrel, up 1.5% in 24 hours; India imports about 9 of every 10 barrels, rupee 94.24, October CPI 6.09%

FINANCE 101: what a second 25 bps repo hike to 5.75% on 04/12/2026 does to a Rs 50 lakh 20-year home loan EMI - EMI Rs 43,391 at 8.50% versus Rs 44,186 at 8.75% (Rs 794 more a month, about Rs 1.9 lakh over the term); repo 5.50% after the 07/10/2026 hike; Moneycontrol poll of 10 economists (13/11/2026) expects 5.75%; MPC meets 2-4 December 2026

MONEY STORY (weekend lesson): Jensen Huang resigned as Nvidia CEO on 11/11/2026 (CFO Colette Kress interim) and the $4 trn stock is down over 10% in a week - key-man risk versus the Nifty 50 index fund, which holds all 50 firms and swapped Wipro for BSE on 30/09/2026 with no action needed from investors

Gold's worst week since June: 24K retail gold lost Rs 72,500 per 100g (Rs 7,250 per 10g) in four sessions to 13/11, back near Rs 1,37,620 per 10g on 14/11; US gold -4.70% on the week, Thursday's 3% slide to a 13-month low; US 10-year yield 5.07%, dollar index 19-month high 103.38, 91.4% odds of a December Fed hike priced; rupee 94.2 cushioned Indian buyers; MCX Dec silver Rs 1,76,543 per kg on 13/11

FESTIVAL GREETING (6:30 PM monitor): Labh Pancham on 14/11/2026 - Kartak Sud Pancham in Vikram Samvat 2083 (Panchami tithi 13/11 8:42 pm to 14/11 11:23 pm, prevails at sunrise); Gujarat's traders reopen after Diwali and open the new ledger (chopda/khatu) with 'Shubh' left, 'Labh' right and a swastik in the middle; 'Labh' means gain - a wish for profit, not a promise; the habit worth copying is opening the OLD statement once a year before starting a new SIP. Tone festival, mood festive, IG reel+story. LinkedIn urn:li:ugcPost:7527359975824945153

FINANCE 101: the real cost of a $150 US stock under LRS - at Rs 94.25 a dollar (13/11/2026) $150 is Rs 14,138, but up to 1.4% forex markup adds Rs 198 and brokerage 0.1% plus 18% GST adds Rs 17, so about Rs 215 (Rs 14,352 total) is gone before the stock moves; LRS cap $2,50,000 a year per PAN across all purposes; 20% TCS only above Rs 10 lakh a year and it is a tax credit, nil below; Groww/Zerodha/Angel One GIFT City rollout October 2026

MONEY STORY (weekend lesson): direct vs regular mutual fund plans - ET illustration (Rs 20,000/mo, 15 years, 12%) puts a direct plan at ~Rs 94.4 lakh vs ~Rs 86 lakh in a regular plan, a Rs 8.4 lakh gap from a 1% fee difference (0.7% vs 1.7% TER); SEBI made direct plans the default on AMC websites and apps from 01/11/2026 (announced 28/10/2026 by chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey); AMFI TER range 0.36-4.3% regular vs 0-2.7% direct

GEOPOLITICS: RBI's net short forward dollar book hit a record $239.2 bn at end-September 2026 (vs $200.06 bn a month earlier) and $40 bn of it falls due within a year; forex reserves $719.547 bn in the week to 06/11/2026, $66.16 bn below the 04/09/2026 record of $785.706 bn, and that week's $2.49 bn rise was 88.5% gold revaluation (gold +$2.205 bn) while foreign currency assets rose just $232 mn; rupee closed 94.24 on 13/11/2026, so imported gold, fuel and phones stay costly for Indian buyers

FINANCE 101: WPI vs CPI - wholesale vs retail inflation. WPI 11.39% in September 2026 (up from 9.92% in August; fuel and power 25.85%, crude petroleum and natural gas 57.32%, manufactured products 9.76%, primary articles 8.67%; base 2022-23; released 14/10/2026) versus CPI 6.09% in October 2026 (two-year high, above RBI's 6% ceiling, food 8.94%, September 5.54%; base 2024=100; released 12/11/2026); October WPI prints Monday 16/11/2026 at 12:00 noon; WPI has no services, rent or retail margin, so wholesale leads retail. Tone caution, mood tense. LinkedIn urn:li:ugcPost:7527912820542365697, IG reel https://www.instagram.com/reel/DfyO_vtDiTI/
